name: Baked Cod with Cherry Tomatoes and New Potatoes

ingredients.display: pinch of dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Toss the halved potatoes with half the oil and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and garlic to the tray and shake to coat in the pan juices.
Sit the cod on top, brush with the remaining oil and season with the oregano and pepper.
Return to the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until the fish flakes cleanly.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve straight from the tray.

name: Prawn and Tenderstem Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Boil the noodles until just tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the tenderstem and pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Tip in the prawns, noodles and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes to heat through.
Scatter over the spring onion and serve.

name: Griddled Chicken Greek-Style Salad

ingredients.display: a third of a cucumber, chopped
a quarter of a red onion, finely sliced
pinch of dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Flatten the chicken breast slightly, rub with half the oil and season with the oregano and pepper.
Griddle over a medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes a side, until cooked through, then rest for 3 minutes.
Combine the leaves, cucumber, tomatoes and onion in a bowl.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and toss through the salad.
Slice the chicken, lay it over the salad and finish with the crumbled feta.

name: Quorn Bolognese with Wholewheat Pasta

ingredients.display: half a small onion, finely chopped
pinch of dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and Quorn mince and fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the passata with a splash of water, season, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta until al dente and drain, saving a little cooking water.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with the reserved water, and top with parmesan.
Double the sauce quantities if you want a portion for tomorrow's lunch.

name: Haddock, Leek and Sweetcorn Chowder

ingredients.display: half a fish or vegetable stock cube

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan and sweat the leek for 5 minutes without colouring.
Add the potatoes, stock cube and 200 ml water, then simmer for 12 minutes until tender.
Pour in the milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the haddock and sweetcorn and poach for 5 minutes, until the fish is opaque.
Season with pepper and serve in a deep bowl.

name: Tofu and Spinach Curry

ingredients.display: half a tin of chopped tomatoes

steps: Press the tofu between kitchen paper, then fry the cubes in the oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and curry paste and fry for 1 minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes with a splash of water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Return the tofu to the pan and wilt in the spinach.
Take off the heat, stir through the yoghurt and serve.

name: Turkey Chilli with Rice

ingredients.display: half a tin of chopped tomatoes
1 tsp chilli powder, cumin and smoked paprika

steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes until softened.
Add the mince and brown it over a high heat, breaking up any lumps.
Stir in the garlic and spices, then add the tomatoes and beans.
Simmer for 20 minutes, adding water if the pan looks dry.
Cook the rice, drain and serve with the chilli spooned over.
Make a triple batch of the chilli and refrigerate portions for lunches.

name: Tempeh Satay Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, then drain and set aside.
Fry the tempeh in the sesame oil over a medium-high heat until browned on both sides.
Add the broccoli, pepper and garlic and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice and 3 tbsp hot water to make a loose sauce.
Toss the noodles and sauce through the pan, then finish with the spring onion.

name: Black Bean Shakshuka

ingredients.display: half a tin of chopped tomatoes
1 tsp smoked paprika and ground cumin

steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes in a small frying pan.
Stir in the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 6 minutes until thickened.
Make three wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook gently for 5 to 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.

name: Teriyaki Salmon with Rice and Tenderstem
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Mix the soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic into a glaze.
Put the rice on to cook.
Sit the salmon in a lined tray, spoon over half the glaze and bake for 12 to 14 minutes.
Steam the tenderstem for 4 minutes until just tender.
Serve the salmon on the rice, spoon over the remaining glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

name: Red Lentil Dhal with Rice
steps: Soften the onion in a dry non-stick pan with a splash of water for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the lentils and 350 ml water, then simmer for 20 minutes until collapsed and thick.
Pour in the coconut milk and wilt the spinach through.
Cook the rice and serve the dhal alongside, topped with the yoghurt.
The dhal keeps for three days and reheats well for lunch.

name: Chicken Fajita Wrap
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices and half the oil.
Fry the pepper and onion in the remaining oil over a high heat for 4 minutes until charred at the edges.
Add the chicken and cook for a further 6 minutes, until cooked through.
Warm the wrap briefly in a dry pan.
Fill with the chicken and vegetables, add the salsa, yoghurt and lime juice, then roll and serve.

name: Egg and Edamame Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice, then spread it out to cool and dry slightly.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok and scramble the beaten egg and egg whites until just set. Remove.
Fry the edamame, peas and garlic over a high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes until piping hot.
Fold the egg back in, scatter with spring onion and serve.

name: Baked Sweet Potato with Cottage Cheese and Black Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Prick the sweet potato and bake for 45 minutes until soft.
Warm the beans in the oil with the paprika for 4 minutes, crushing a few against the pan.
Stir the spinach through the beans until wilted.
Split the potato open and spoon in the bean mixture.
Top with the cottage cheese and salsa and serve.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Rice

ingredients.display: half a tin of chopped tomatoes

steps: Coat the chicken in half the curry paste and leave for 10 minutes while you prepare everything else.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and remaining paste.
Add the chicken and sear for 4 minutes, turning to colour all sides.
Pour in the tomatoes and 100 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice. Take the curry off the heat, stir in the yoghurt and serve with the rice.
Cook double the curry and keep a portion for lunch the next day.

name: Harissa Halloumi and Chickpea Traybake

ingredients.display: half a red onion, cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan.
Toss the pepper, courgette, onion and chickpeas with the oil and harissa in a roasting tray.
Roast for 20 minutes, shaking the tray once.
Lay the halloumi over the vegetables and roast for a further 10 minutes until golden.
Serve straight from the tray.

name: Mushroom and Pea Risotto

ingredients.display: half a small onion, finely chopped

steps: Fry the mushrooms in half the oil over a high heat until browned, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 6 minutes.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute, then add the stock cube dissolved in 400 ml hot water, a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed.
After about 20 minutes, when the rice is tender, stir in the peas and mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and beat in the quark and parmesan until creamy. Season and serve.

name: Black Bean Chilli with Quinoa

ingredients.display: half a tin of chopped tomatoes
1 tsp chilli powder, cumin and smoked paprika

steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Tip in both tins of beans and the tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Cook the quinoa in plenty of water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Serve the chilli over the quinoa with the cheddar scattered on top.
The chilli freezes well and makes a strong next-day lunch.

name: Pork Loin with Mustard Mash and Green Beans
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender.
Season the pork and fry in the oil over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes a side, then rest for 5 minutes.
Steam the green beans for 4 minutes.
Crush the drained potatoes with the milk, butter and mustard and season with pepper.
Slice the pork and serve with the mash and beans, spooning over any resting juices.

name: Roast Chicken Thigh and Vegetable Traybake

ingredients.display: 1 tsp dried thyme and black pepper

steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan.
Toss the potatoes and vegetables with the oil, garlic and half the seasoning, then roast for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken thighs, sit them on top and roast for a further 25 minutes.
Check the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.
Squeeze over the lemon juice before serving.
Roast a second tray at the same time for tomorrow's lunch.

name: Tuna and Sweetcorn Pasta Bake

ingredients.display: 2 tins of tuna in spring water, drained
pinch of dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Heat the oven to 190C fan and cook the pasta two minutes short of the packet time.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the passata, milk and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir the drained pasta, tuna and sweetcorn into the sauce and season.
Tip into an ovenproof dish and scatter over the cheddar.
Bake for 15 minutes until bubbling and browned on top.
Double the quantities and bake in a larger dish for leftovers.

name: Pan-Fried Sirloin with New Potatoes and Mushrooms

ingredients.display: pinch of sea salt and black pepper

steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, then toss with half the oil and crush lightly.
Season the steak and fry in the remaining oil over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Add the butter to the pan for the last minute and baste the steak, then rest it for 5 minutes.
Fry the mushrooms in the same pan until browned.
Steam the tenderstem for 4 minutes and serve everything with the mustard alongside.

name: Salmon, Lemon and Spinach Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, reserving a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Fry the salmon in the oil for 4 minutes a side, then flake it into large pieces and discard the skin.
Add the garlic to the pan for 30 seconds, then stir in the cream cheese and a splash of pasta water.
Wilt the spinach into the sauce and add the lemon juice.
Toss through the pasta and salmon, loosen with more pasta water, and finish with parmesan and pepper.

name: Lean Beef Cottage Pie

ingredients.display: 300 g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps: Brown the mince in a dry pan over a high heat, then add the onion and carrot and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the passata, stock cube and 150 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes, drain, then mash with the milk and butter.
Stir the peas into the mince and transfer to an ovenproof dish.
Spread the mash on top, rough up the surface with a fork and bake at 200C fan for 20 minutes until golden.
Build two or three portions at once and refrigerate or freeze the extras.

name: Crispy Tofu Peanut Noodles
steps: Press the tofu dry, then fry in the sesame oil over a high heat until crisp on all sides.
Cook the noodles and drain.
Add the broccoli and pepper to the pan and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Loosen the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice and 3 tbsp hot water.
Toss the noodles and sauce through the pan, then top with spring onion and chilli.

name: Chicken, Sweet Potato And Tenderstem Tray

ingredients.display: 1 large sweet potato (250 g), in wedges
1 tsp smoked paprika and black pepper

steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Toss the sweet potato wedges with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil and the paprika and add it to the tray.
Roast for 12 minutes, adding the tenderstem for the last 8 minutes.
Stir the garlic and lemon juice into the yoghurt and spoon over to serve.

name: Cod And Lentil Tomato Stew
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the paprika.
Add the tomatoes and lentils and simmer for 8 minutes.
Sit the cod on top, cover and cook for 8 minutes until the fish flakes.
Stir the spinach through the sauce and finish with the lemon juice.

name: Turkey Bolognese With Wholewheat Pasta

ingredients.display: 1 tsp dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Brown the turkey mince in the oil over a high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the onion, garlic and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the passata with the oregano and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the pasta until al dente, drain and stir through the sauce.

name: Tofu And Edamame Rice Stir-Fry

ingredients.display: a little over 1/2 a block (225 g) firm tofu, cubed

steps: Cook the rice according to the packet and keep warm.
Press the tofu dry and fry in the sesame oil over a high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the ginger, garlic, pepper, tenderstem and edamame and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Splash in the soy sauce with 2 tbsp water and serve over the rice.

name: Lentil And Mozzarella Courgette Bake

ingredients.display: 2/3 of a ball (80 g) light mozzarella, torn
1 tsp dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Simmer the lentils in 350 ml water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain any excess.
Soften the onion, garlic and courgette in the oil for 6 minutes.
Stir in the passata, oregano and lentils and tip into a small baking dish.
Dot with the cottage cheese, scatter over the mozzarella and bake at 200C fan for 15 minutes.

name: Harissa Chicken And Butter Bean Stew
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in the oil for 4 minutes a side, then lift out.
Soften the onion and garlic for 5 minutes and stir in the harissa.
Add the passata, butter beans and 100 ml water and return the chicken.
Simmer for 18 minutes, stir in the spinach and finish with the lemon juice.
